name: ordered rewriting guard for permutative rules
mechanism: detect at ingestion that a rule only permutes its variables, and at application refuse the rewrite unless the result is smaller under a fixed term order, so commutativity-like rules cannot loop
fails_when: only pure variable permutations are detected; two-rule loops are invisible
